articles.title: PSA: Patch your Plex media server before someone hacks it
articles.content: A researcher says attacks chaining 4 vulnerabilities is hacking unpatched boxes.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s proposed SpaceX stock giveaway would go into ‘Trump Accounts’
articles.content: President Donald Trump announced this afternoon that Elon Musk's SpaceX shares for children will be given through Trump Accounts. Musk said earlier today that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to "every kid in America" sometime next year.
